verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt index at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/llms.txt that lists the documentation guides. Docs pages are served as raw markdown (.md), with `agentTools.projectIndex` frontmatter pointing back to that llms.txt. A machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema is also publicly retrievable, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party prose explaining how to use these agent-facing docs, and evidence of an expanded full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).
